spec.query:
from(bucket: "weatherdata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "observed")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corrected_forecast" and r._field == "temp" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "corrected")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error" and r._field == "temp_error" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "error")

from(bucket: "weatherdata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "speed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 3.6 }))
  |> yield(name: "observed")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corrected_forecast" and r._field == "wind_speed" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 3.6 }))
  |> yield(name: "corrected")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error" and r._field == "wind_speed_error" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 3.6 }))
  |> yield(name: "error")

from(bucket: "weatherdata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and (r._field == "pressure" or r._field == "quality_valid" or r._field == "pressure_basis") and r.topic == "pressure/telemetry" and r.station == "local-pressure")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "pressure", _value: if exists r.pressure and r.quality_valid == true and r.pressure_basis == "legacy_sea_level_corrected" then float(v: r.pressure) else float(v: "NaN")}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "topic", "station"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "observed")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corrected_forecast" and r._field == "pressure" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "corrected")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error" and r._field == "pressure_error" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "error")

from(bucket: "weatherdata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "humidity")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "observed")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corrected_forecast" and r._field == "humidity" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "corrected")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error" and r._field == "humidity_error" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "error")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "intermediate_features" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pressure_gradient" or r._field == "temp_trend" or r._field == "wind_shift_indicator" or r._field == "temp_rolling_mean")
  |> yield(name: "features")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_error" or r._field == "wind_speed_error" or r._field == "wind_dir_error" or r._field == "pressure_error" or r._field == "humidity_error" or r._field == "precipitation_error")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["horizon", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "latest")

from(bucket: "weatherdata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "direction")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "observed")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corrected_forecast" and r._field == "wind_dir" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "corrected")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error" and r._field == "wind_dir_error" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "error")

from(bucket: "weatherdata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rainfall" and r._field == "rainfall_mm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "observed")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_aligned" and r._field == "precipitation" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "forecast")

from(bucket: "forecast_derived")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_error" and r._field == "precipitation_error" and r.horizon == "${horizon}")
  |> yield(name: "error")
